invariants: Every required destination declares one byte identity and one archive identifier.
A destination present in the signed filesystem manifest must match its approved digest, byte count, and archive.
A destination absent from the filesystem manifest resolves only when its approved digest exists in its approved signed archive.
Every resolved binding names the content-addressed archive member for its expected SHA-256.

findings.summary: Seven required MIL runtime paths lacked filesystem-manifest rows although their signed content objects existed.
findings.repair: Require an archive identifier beside every requested identity and resolve an absent destination through that exact signed archive object.

exclusions: The P0-PB-06 run authenticates and extracts the selected archive objects.
